<?php // main.php — webhook outbound sender: adapter dispatch + payload delivery
declare(strict_types=1);
require_once __DIR__ . '/helper.php';

const ADAPTER_DIR = __DIR__ . '/adapters';

// ---- Entry 1: response format via GET ----
$fmt = $_GET['format'] ?? 'json';
if (in_array($fmt, ['json', 'form', 'xml'], true)) {
    require ADAPTER_DIR . '/' . $fmt . '.php'; // Flow A sink (whitelisted)
} else {
    $fmt = 'json';
}

// ---- Entry 2: footer template via POST ----
$tplPath = resolve_template($_POST['tpl'] ?? '');
if ($tplPath !== null) {
    require $tplPath; // Flow B sink (path-checked)
}

// ---- Entry 3: partner adapter via HTTP header ----
$adapterId = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_HOOK_ADAPTER'] ?? '';
if ($adapterId !== '') {
    load_adapter($adapterId); // Flow C -> helper.php:24
}

$tag = $_GET['tag'] ?? '';
error_log('dispatch tag=' . $tag); // decoy: tainted but no include sink

$payload = json_encode(['event' => $fmt, 'data' => $_POST['data'] ?? '', 'ts' => time()]);
$endpoint = getenv('HOOK_ENDPOINT') ?: 'https://hooks.internal.example/ingest';
$ch = curl_init($endpoint);
curl_setopt_array($ch, [
    CURLOPT_POST => true,
    CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => $payload,
    CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => ['Content-Type: application/json', 'X-Hook-Token: ' . (getenv('HOOK_TOKEN') ?: '')],
    CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
]);
curl_exec($ch);
curl_close($ch);

<?php // helper.php — template resolution and adapter loading for the sender
declare(strict_types=1);

function resolve_template(?string $tpl): ?string {
    if ($tpl === null || $tpl === '') {
        return null;
    }
    $base = realpath(__DIR__ . '/templates');
    $cand = realpath(__DIR__ . '/templates/' . $tpl);
    if ($cand === false || strpos($cand, $base . DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR) !== 0) {
        return null; // Flow B defense: realpath + directory prefix check
    }
    return $cand;
}

function load_adapter(string $raw): void {
    // Hardening: strip traversal and known-dangerous wrappers before resolution
    $name = str_replace(['..', 'php://', 'data://', 'phar://', 'zip://'], '', trim($raw));
    if (preg_match('#^[a-z][a-z0-9+.\-]*://#i', $name)) {
        $path = $name; // remote adapter registry: partner-supplied URL allowed
    } else {
        $path = ADAPTER_DIR . '/' . basename($name) . '.php';
    }
    require $path; // Flow C sink
    if (!class_exists('HookAdapter')) {
        throw new RuntimeException('adapter must define class HookAdapter');
    }
}
